normalizationDecision.startBoundaryPolicy: Keep official Section 5 start at/near the Mösjön/Törnsfall shelter as the source GPX defines it. Record the 90.9 m Section 4/5 discrepancy as endpoint-cluster/handoff metadata rather than snapping Section 5 to OSM or the Section 4 endpoint silently.

normalizationDecision.distancePolicy: Use officialDistanceKm=21 for public stage identity and store computedDistanceKm=21.225 as geometry metadata.

commuteAccess.summary: Transit is workable but uneven. Almvik/Blekhem is the strongest fixed-route access cluster via regular KLT lines 23/25. The start and finish depend on weak fixed stops, school-route buses, or booked Närtrafik and should not be presented as simple walk-up transit endpoints.

start.confidence: medium-high for coordinates; medium-low for practical visitor usability
start.caveats: Weekday school-route pattern with school-holiday exclusions and some set-down-only behavior. Pair with Närtrafik Almvik rather than treating as robust public transport.

start.confidence: medium-high for service existence; medium for exact endpoint pickup
start.caveats: Flexible booked access only. Must be booked by phone, pickup/dropoff is confirmed during booking, pets are not allowed, and pickup at the Mösjön/Törnsfall shelter itself must be confirmed with KLT.

midpoints.caveats: Best fixed-route midpoint access. Verify current trip times before user-facing publication, especially after the 2026-06-15 summer timetable switch.

end.confidence: medium-high for location; low-medium for practical usability

fireRules: Fire-ban status is dynamic. Länsstyrelsen Kalmar showed no fire ban for Västervik when checked on 2026-04-29, but this must be refreshed before import/use.
Västervik municipality states an annual fire ban in detailed-planned areas from May 2 through September 29; Section 5 is mostly rural, but settlement/detail-plan areas need caution.
Naturskyddsföreningen guidance says any fire at shelters/fireplaces is a personal responsibility and must be avoided during drought/fire bans and fully extinguished.
wasteAndToilets: Naturskyddsföreningen explicitly says there is no waste collection on the trail.
TC/dry toilets are confirmed at start and end by official section pages, but the end toilet coordinate remains unresolved.
campingNotes: No official bookable camping was found for this section.
Shelters are not bookable and should be shared according to general Tjustleden practical guidance.
Final approach to Källtorp runs through/near pasture; official text says the parallel road can be used if grazing animals are too close.

sourceContradictions.impact: Normalize endpoint facility naming carefully and keep aliases in import notes.
